extracted.name: Portuguese Favas
extracted.description: Onions and garlic are simmered in a tomato sauce with herbs and spices. Fava beans are gently folded into the sauce to absorb its rich flavors.
instruction_lines: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Saute onion and garlic until golden brown. Stir in red pepper flakes, tomato sauce, hot water, parsley, salt, pepper and paprika. Bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes.
Gently stir in fava beans. Remove from heat and let stand for several minutes to allow flavors to meld.
